rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when an employer is hiring staff or workers.

example.english: Our company is looking to recruit; if you’re interested, come for an interview soon.
example.traditional: 我哋公司最近請人，有興趣就快啲嚟見工啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 ceng2 jan4 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 zau6 faai3 di1 lai4 gin3 gung1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for organized recruitment of members, volunteers, team players, or other groups rather than ordinary staff hiring.

example.english: The volunteer team plans to recruit new members next month.
example.traditional: 義工隊下個月會招募新隊員。
example.jyutping: ji6 gung1 deoi6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 ziu1 mou6 san1 deoi6 jyun4
